# TTRPG Sheet Kit — reference for LLMs

Obsidian plugin. Use it to write tabletop RPG character sheets in Markdown with clickable counters,
checkbox tracks and multi-column layouts. Any game system. Output plain Markdown; the plugin renders it.

Two syntaxes only:
1. ```` ```ttrpgsk-counters ```` fenced block, YAML inside → counters / tracks.
2. `> [!ttrpgsk-columns]` callout → content laid out in columns.

Everything else is normal Obsidian Markdown (headings, lists, tables, `[[links]]`, `![[embeds]]`).

## 1. Counter block

````
```ttrpgsk-counters
key: <value>
```
````

### Counter value forms
| Form | Example | Result |
|---|---|---|
| integer | `gold: 47` | counter, −/+ buttons |
| value/max string | `hp: 37/44` | counter with maximum, shown `37/44` |
| flow map | `hp: { label: Hit points, value: 37, max: 44 }` | counter with options |
| block map | `hp:`<br>`  label: Hit points`<br>`  value: 37` | same as flow map |

### Counter fields (map forms)
| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` (alias `name`) | string | the key | display name |
| `value` | integer or `"a/b"` | 0 | `"a/b"` sets value a and max b |
| `max` | integer | none | clicks clamp to it |
| `min` | integer or `null` | 0 | **default 0: negative values need `min: null`** |
| `step` | integer | 1 | Shift+click = step × 5 |
| `type` | `number` \| `track` | `number` | `track` = row of `max` checkboxes, `value` = filled boxes; needs `max` |
| `mod` | boolean | false | shows D&D modifier `floor((v-10)/2)`, e.g. 14 → (+2) |
| `reset` | `{ on: <moment>, to: max \| min \| <integer> }` | none | **both `on` and `to` required**; see Resets |

### Resets
`reset: { on: long, to: max }` — the plugin's "Reset…" command sets the counter to `to` for the chosen moment `on`.
- `on`: free name (`short`, `long`, `session`, `day`…). `long` also triggers `short`.
- `to`: `max` (needs `max`), `min` (needs a non-null `min`), or an integer.
- Typical: HP `{ on: long, to: max }`; spell slots / daily uses as tracks `{ on: long, to: min }`;
  short-rest features `{ on: short, to: min }`; Fate points `{ on: session, to: <refresh> }`.
- Never write `reset: long` alone: it is invalid.

### Block options (top-level keys)
| Key | Values |
|---|---|
| `label` (alias `name`) | block title |
| `layout` | `vertical` (default: one row per counter) \| `horizontal` (side by side, label on top, wraps) |
| `mod` | `true` → modifier on every counter |

`label`, `name`, `layout`, `mod` are **reserved**: never use them as counter keys.

### Groups (several titled groups in one block)
A top-level key whose value is a map containing `items:` is a group. Group options: `label`, `layout`, `mod`.
Block-level `layout`/`mod` are inherited by groups.

```yaml
coins:
  label: Coins
  layout: horizontal
  items:
    gp: { label: Gold, value: 47 }
    sp: { label: Silver, value: 15 }
ammo:
  label: Ammunition
  items:
    arrows: { label: Arrows, value: 18, max: 40 }
```

If a block contains at least one group, top-level counters outside groups are **ignored**. Don't mix.

## 2. Columns callout

```
> [!ttrpgsk-columns] Optional title
> - item
> - item
```

- `|3` → three columns, `|plain` → no border/title, combine: `> [!ttrpgsk-columns|3 plain]`. Default: 2 columns, bordered.
- Content: any Markdown. Lists split across columns, list items never break.
- Counter blocks inside the callout: prefix **every** line with `> `, including the fences. Several blocks in one callout are distributed across the columns; a block never splits.
- An embedded note is split across columns: `> ![[Note name]]`.
- Single column on phones.

## 3. Rules that avoid broken output

1. Values are **integers only**. No decimals, no units in `value` (put units in `label`: `Rations (days)`).
2. Keys: unique within their block/group, no spaces (use `snake_case`), not reserved.
3. Quote labels containing `:` `,` `#` `{` `}` `[` `]` or starting with `*` `&` `!` `%` `@`: `label: "STR: Strength"`.
4. A counter whose value can't be parsed is silently skipped.
5. Keep `value` on the counter's own line (short/flow form) or on its own `value:` line (block form): the plugin edits that number in place when clicked.
6. Tracks: always set `max`; `value` ≤ `max`. Use for death saves, stress, spell slots, daily uses, inspiration.
7. Add `reset` to resources that refill (HP, slots, limited uses); leave it out for coins, ammo, XP.
8. Use counters only for values that change during play (HP, slots, coins, ammo, XP). Static numbers (AC, speed, skill bonuses) stay as plain text.
9. YAML comments (`# ...`) are allowed and preserved.
10. Never put a counter block inside a table or a list item.

## 4. Recommended sheet structure

1. `# Name`, one italic line with class/level/background.
2. Static stats as bold-label lines, optionally in `> [!ttrpgsk-columns|plain]`.
3. Ability scores: one `horizontal` block, `mod: true` for d20 systems.
4. Resources (HP, temp HP, hit dice, death saves, inspiration): counters + tracks, several blocks side by side in a plain columns callout.
5. Spell slots as tracks; spell list as lists, or a separate note embedded in a columns callout.
6. Features as a list in `[!ttrpgsk-columns|plain]`; limited uses as tracks right after.
7. Coins as a `horizontal` group; consumables as a vertical group with `max` where useful.
8. Inventory list in `[!ttrpgsk-columns|3 plain]`.
9. Progress (XP with `step: 100`, reputation with `min: null` if it can go negative).

## 5. Minimal complete example

````markdown
# Brakka Ironfist
*Dwarf Fighter 3 · Soldier*

> [!ttrpgsk-columns|plain]
> **Armor Class** 18 · **Speed** 25 ft.
>
> **Proficiency bonus** +2 · **Passive Perception** 11

```ttrpgsk-counters
layout: horizontal
mod: true
STR: 16
DEX: 10
CON: 16
INT: 8
WIS: 12
CHA: 10
```

> [!ttrpgsk-columns|plain]
> ```ttrpgsk-counters
> label: Hit points
> hp: { label: Current, value: 31, max: 31, reset: { on: long, to: max } }
> temp_hp: { label: Temporary, value: 0 }
> hit_dice: { label: Hit dice (d10), value: 3/3 }
> ```
> ```ttrpgsk-counters
> label: Resources
> second_wind: { label: Second Wind, type: track, max: 1, value: 0, reset: { on: short, to: min } }
> action_surge: { label: Action Surge, type: track, max: 1, value: 0, reset: { on: short, to: min } }
> death_fail: { label: Death save failures, type: track, max: 3, value: 0 }
> ```

```ttrpgsk-counters
coins:
  label: Coins
  layout: horizontal
  items:
    gp: { label: Gold, value: 25 }
    sp: { label: Silver, value: 8 }
gear:
  label: Consumables
  items:
    bolts: { label: Crossbow bolts, value: 20, max: 20 }
    potions: { label: Potions of healing, value: 1 }
```

> [!ttrpgsk-columns|3 plain]
> - Battleaxe
> - Shield
> - Chain mail
> - Light crossbow
> - Explorer's pack
````
